breakpoint_clusters.description: All clusters from cluster_breakpoints.py. One row per cluster_id with centroid_mb, span_kb, methods, families, n_families, cross_method, pos_by_method, event_classes.

cross_method_validated_breakpoints.description: Tier 1 — subset of breakpoint_clusters where cross_method == true (>=2 independent families agree ≤tol).

recurrent_breakpoints.description: Tier 2 — clusters with multiple methods from the SAME family. Real but single-method-family.

reciprocity_table.description: BP3c — zones validated from BOTH anchors (Cgar AND Cmac). 'Supported from both directions' evidence tier.

pairwise_summary.description: Per-(edge × species) table — which species contribute to each edge in the focal frame.

recipe.description: Subprocess plan: which scripts to run, in what order, with what args. Runners consume this; the registry never executes.
